_comment: Copy to profile.json and edit. This is the only file you need to change: the research agent reads everything else from SAM.gov. profile.json is gitignored so your codes stay out of the shared repo.
_naics: NAICS codes from your SAM.gov registration. One search covers all of them.
_psc: Optional Product Service Codes. Leave [] to search by NAICS only.
_set_aside_eligibility: Set-asides you can bid on, by SAM code: SBA/SBP small business, 8A/8AN 8(a), HZC/HZS HUBZone, SDVOSBC/SDVOSBS service-disabled veteran, WOSB/WOSBSS women-owned, EDWOSB/EDWOSBSS economically disadvantaged WOSB, VSA/VSS veteran, ISBEE/IEE Indian economic enterprise. Unrestricted notices are always kept. Delete this key to skip set-aside filtering entirely.
_capabilities: What you actually do, in plain words. The agent scores each notice's fit against this list, so be specific: 'Django and React web apps' beats 'software'.
_exclusions: Optional: work you never want surfaced even when the codes match, e.g. hardware resale. The agent marks these skip.
